scope: Operational module hardening; source and renderer validation

coverage: zero-row writes from stale or unauthorized actors

checks.runtime: Chromium / Next development server; real /finance and /messages route components
coverage: failed finance refresh preserves loaded records
case switch and cancelable programmatic navigation respect unsaved drafts
newest 100 messages plus earlier history pagination
late conversation fetch cannot replace selected thread
unrelated duplicate-key failure cannot clear a message
text entered during sending survives completion
composer and Send visible at the top of 1366x768 and 1440x1000 desktop viewports
100 to 120 history messages increase only the inner scroll extent
mobile 390x844 thread/chat single-column access without horizontal overflow

limits: Live Supabase, real patient records and clinical or regulatory approval were not verified.
Appointment overlap detection remains a client preflight; simultaneous creation from different clients is not guaranteed collision-free by a database constraint.
Financial and message drafts are session-memory data with navigation protection, not persistent crash-recovery storage.
Community was inspected but not modified or browser-tested in this operational hardening task.
Browser evidence covers development routes and synthetic HTTP responses; it does not establish live-service or Windows installer readiness.
